LEFT arm: leftElbow 65→30 (less bent, extended for trailing), shoulderFwdL 0→+80 (BEHIND per corrected convention + = behind, projects DOWN in world for supine — brings LEFT wrist down toward ground). RIGHT arm: rightShoulder -42→-30 (slight symmetrize, less abducted), rightElbow 45→60 (more bent, relaxed). Result: head(0,0.36,-0.84) hip(0,0.02,-0.12) ankle(±0.11,0.43,0.68) — smile U (head UP, feet UP, hip LOW) ✓. lWr(-0.34,-0.46,-0.66) — DOWN/LEFT/BACK, trailing off LEFT side toward ground (rig-limited: y=-0.46 not quite ground y=-0.88). rWr(0.74,0.26,-0.17) — UP/RIGHT, relaxed (not trailing).
